remarks: Set within a meticulously maintained 21-unit complex with mature landscaping and an outdoor pool, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy low-maintenance living in one of Darien's most walkable and convenient locations - just moments to town, the commuter train, award-winning schools, beaches, I-95, and everyday amenities. Welcome to 13 Darien Close! Filled with natural light and thoughtfully updated throughout, this special residence blends style, comfort, and convenience in one of Darien's most desirable condominium communities. Numerous improvements since 2020 enhance both form and function.  The renovated eat-in kitchen features quartz countertops, tile backsplash, hardwood floors, and stainless steel appliances. Hardwood flooring continues throughout the upper level, where you'll find the spacious primary suite, a second bedroom and additional full bath, plus generous closet space.  The dramatic living room showcases soaring cathedral ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and an electric fireplace that creates the perfect focal point for relaxing or entertaining. Sliders open to a private patio, offering seamless indoor/outdoor living. The main level also includes an updated powder room and direct access to the attached garage.  Exceptional extra space awaits in the finished lower level with new flooring and flexible use as a media room, home office, gym, playroom, or guest overflow space. There is abundant storage throughout, including a cedar closet in attic.
